judge.rationale: The candidate stopped mid-implementation (leaving `.lore/dod.md` in the tree with unchecked items) and missed the majority of the acceptance criteria. While basic `ajv` validation and registration-time compilation work in `ToolRegistry`, dynamic schemas from function-valued definitions are recompiled on every call without caching by schema object (`WeakMap`), and `register` also unconditionally compiles the initial schema of a dynamic tool. Most required unit tests in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts` (extra property pass-through, dynamic schema changes, unknown tool throw, single compilation for static tools) and the test in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts` are missing, placed instead in an unrequested `registry.acceptance.test.ts` file. Finally, all required documentation updates (`README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`) were omitted, and `CHANGELOG.md` only partially describes the change.
